title: Captain Prabhakar
desc: Prabhakaran, a forest officer, is assigned to arrest the notorious smuggler Veerabhadran. While duty calls, Parabhakaran also decides to avenge his friend's death.

title: Nyayam Ketkiren
desc: When a newly married couple falls victim to a heinous crime, the bride's brother takes it upon himself to seek retribution and punish the culprits.

title: Chinna Muthu
desc: Chinna Muthu, a valiant young man, opposes the atrocities of rich landlords in his village. His life turns upside down when his sister is impregnated by Sevatha Pandi, a wealthy man.

title: Annan
desc: Velan feels happy when his sister, Lakshmi, marries Selvam, a police officer. However, Velan is shocked when Selvam accuses him of killing his father.

title: Uthama Rasa
desc: Meenu, a bubbly girl, is in love with Chinnaiya, the village leader. Things change when Marudhu, who is the son of Chinnaiya's rival, Parama Thevar, falls for Meenu.
